answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Granted shepherd flockmaster certificate with shepherds association attestation changes that arithmetic: a certificate the association renews after flock audits, so the fable for each fake is paid in the real world. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the ripple of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out. The sparrow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
